svg.title: Career: revision history from mechanical engineering (2015) to ML platforms (2026)
svg.desc: Timeline drawn as a chain dimension from 2015 to 2026 with revision triangles, and a revision history table, latest first. Rev J, JUL 2026 – NOW, FREDDIE MAC, Finance · ML forecasting: Rejoined Mercury Plus (M+) as a senior backend developer: FastAPI microservices on AWS EKS/ECS that serve machine-learning models for large-scale forecasting. Rev H, MAY 2025 – JUL 2026, CAPITAL ONE, Finance · card portfolio decisioning: Platform of 50+ AWS microservices. Event-driven serverless pipeline: EventBridge → Lambda → DynamoDB Streams → Step Functions → Glue/Spark. Owned the circuit-breaker precheck rollout across four teams via Optimizely flags; Playwright BDD; Claude Code + MCP. Rev G, JAN 2023 – MAY 2025, FREDDIE MAC, Finance · ML forecasting: Architect and backend lead of M+. Moved forecast jobs onto a queue + EKS worker (5x quarter-end load); large-result queries 25% faster; 3,000 → 1,000-line refactor (+20% perf); 85% coverage gate in CI; Tableau to production; local RAG. Rev F, APR 2022 – JAN 2023, AGERO, Serverless data sync: FastAPI on AWS Lambda from scratch. S3 events → EventBridge → Lambda → MongoDB data sync; GitHub Actions CI/CD; React job dashboard. Rev E, MAY 2019 – APR 2022, HUMANA, Healthcare · specialty pharmacy: Led the backend agile team. Tesseract OCR services wired to .NET apps via Flask: ~200K faxes a month, no lost documents. Owned the C#/.NET Web API for Utilization and Case Management. Rev D, JUN 2018 – MAY 2019, McKESSON, Pharma SaaS: Flask + MS SQL; Angular + C# Web API; an Express/Node portal built test-first (TDD). Rev C, SEP 2017 – MAY 2018, WOOLWORTHS, Retail · Sydney: ASP.NET / C# N-tier modules; Azure App Insights monitoring; Sev-1 incident response. Rev B, JAN 2016 – AUG 2017, CVS HEALTH, Pharmacy apps: Led API development. AngularJS single-page app from scratch on Web API + SQL Server. Rev A, 2015, ANNA UNIVERSITY, BE Mechanical Engineering: The origin story: from gears to graphs.
svg.text: 10+ years, 5 domains · flags mark led teams · rev letters skip I and O, per drafting practice
